claim_boundary: This is a discovery-data additive-gradient active-subspace pilot for the exact frozen linear and nonlinear readout energies at the first-density cut. It ranks unit additive perturbation directions. It is not the finite projector-loss Hessian, the exact checkpoint-only ODT coefficient environment, or a nonlinear fidelity certificate.

normalization.dataset: equal mean over frozen discovery configurations
normalization.magnetic: mean over every complete magnetic multiplet
normalization.per_configuration_energy: each branch energy is divided by sqrt(num_atoms)
